title: Tool-preference groups v1 (input)
description: Input to `tools preference`: per group, one user request and a tool list in which two tools (twins A and B) do the job equally well, plus distractors that do not. The probe varies one twin at a time (docs/tool-preference.md).

system.description: System prompt for every item; an empty string sends none. Default: a neutral 'use tools when they help' prompt.

cues.description: Override the sentence a factor appends to the treated twin's description.

domain.description: Free-form label, carried to the results for slicing.

expect.description: `none`: no tool is needed (a control group, scored as over-calling). Default `call`.

parameters.description: JSON Schema of the arguments (OpenAI tools format).

vendor_name.description: Branded name for the `vendor_name` factor; without it the factor is skipped for this twin.

detail.description: Extra capability sentence for `long_desc`; without it the factor is skipped.

exclusion.description: 'Do NOT use for …' sentence for `exclusion`; without it the factor is skipped.
